faq.question: Can eye shape really determine personality?
faq.answer: Eye shape does not determine destiny, but traditional face reading suggests it reflects emotional and social tendencies.

faq.question: Are eye readings scientifically proven?
faq.answer: Modern psychology studies facial expressions and micro-expressions, but personality interpretation through eye shape remains symbolic rather than scientific.

content.text: Why Eyes Are Called the Window to Personality
Across many traditions, the eyes are seen as the most expressive part of the face. They reveal emotional intensity, attention patterns, and openness to the world.
Larger eyes are often associated with emotional sensitivity, curiosity, and expressiveness. Smaller or narrower eyes are traditionally linked to focus, discipline, and strategic thinking.
Wider-set eyes are symbolically connected with broad perspective and open-mindedness, while closer-set eyes may reflect detail orientation and concentration.
A steady, direct gaze often suggests confidence and decisiveness. Softer or shifting eye contact may indicate adaptability or heightened emotional awareness.
Eye interpretation in face reading is not about predicting fate. Instead, it offers a symbolic framework to understand emotional patterns and interpersonal style.
